description: This file contains a class `ObjectStreams` with a method `ReadPdfWithObjectStreams` that demonstrates reading PDF files, specifically focusing on PDFs with object streams, using the PdfSharp library. It includes code for loading PDFs, timing the load operations, and saving files, with many commented-out paths for different PDF test files.

classes.name: ObjectStreams
classes.description: A class providing functionality to read PDFs with object streams, mainly for testing or processing PDFs in the context of PDFsharp.

methods.name: ReadPdfWithObjectStreams
methods.description: Static method that loads PDF files from a specified directory, times the PDF loading process, and saves the PDFs to temporary files.
